title: Tôi cần giúp đỡ bây giờ
pronunciation: Toi can giup do bay gio
summary: Say "I need help now" with Tôi cần giúp đỡ bây giờ, then use the notes below to adjust tone and next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: For travelers, Tôi cần giúp đỡ bây giờ is the phrase to keep ready for "I need help now" in lost items, help, managers, and recovery moments. This is for when the trip is off track and you need another person to help solve the practical problem. It works best when you focus on putting the need first and leaving room for the helper to confirm the detail. After you say it, listen for a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question; the next rows help you keep the exchange moving.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Tôi cần giúp đỡ bây giờ as your first sentence for "I need help now". This is for when the trip is off track and you need another person to help solve the practical problem. Leave a short pause after the phrase so the other person can answer with a confirmation, a handoff, a price, or a follow-up question. Keep a receipt, room number, ride detail, or last location visible when it helps staff trace the problem.
